change_summary: Changed kernel_function grid from static `(triton.cdiv(xnumel, 128),)` to dynamic `lambda META: (triton.cdiv(xnumel, META['XBLOCK']),)` so the grid correctly scales with the autotuned XBLOCK (e.g., 245 blocks for XBLOCK=32 instead of 62), covering all 132 SMs; R0_BLOCK kept at 256 (must be power of 2 for tl.arange).
